from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader

# Build cover page using a hand-written minimal PDF is handled in another step.
print("placeholder")

"""Generate a cover page PDF (letter size) with title and current date."""
from datetime import date

# Helvetica / Helvetica-Bold widths (Adobe AFM, in 1/1000 em units)
HELV = {
    ' ': 278, 'A': 667, 'B': 667, 'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 611,
    'G': 778, 'H': 722, 'I': 278, 'J': 500, 'K': 667, 'L': 556, 'M': 833,
    'N': 722, 'O': 778, 'P': 667, 'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611,
    'U': 722, 'V': 667, 'W': 944, 'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611,
    'a': 556, 'b': 556, 'c': 500, 'd': 556, 'e': 556, 'f': 278, 'g': 556,
    'h': 556, 'i': 222, 'j': 222, 'k': 500, 'l': 222, 'm': 833, 'n': 556,
    'o': 556, 'p': 556, 'q': 556, 'r': 333, 's': 500, 't': 278, 'u': 556,
    'v': 500, 'w': 722, 'x': 500, 'y': 500, 'z': 500,
    '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556, '4': 556, '5': 556,
    '6': 556, '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556, ',': 278, '.': 278, '-': 333,
}
HELV_BOLD = {
    ' ': 278, 'A': 722, 'B': 722, 'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 611,
    'G': 778, 'H': 722, 'I': 278, 'J': 556, 'K': 722, 'L': 611, 'M': 833,
    'N': 722, 'O': 778, 'P': 667, 'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611,
    'U': 722, 'V': 667, 'W': 944, 'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611,
    'a': 556, 'b': 556, 'c': 500, 'd': 556, 'e': 556, 'f': 278, 'g': 556,
    'h': 556, 'i': 222, 'j': 222, 'k': 500, 'l': 222, 'm': 833, 'n': 556,
    'o': 556, 'p': 556, 'q': 556, 'r': 333, 's': 500, 't': 278, 'u': 556,
    'v': 500, 'w': 722, 'x': 500, 'y': 500, 'z': 500,
    '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556, '4': 556, '5': 556,
    '6': 556, '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556, ',': 278, '.': 278, '-': 333,
}


def text_width(text, size, widths):
    return sum(widths.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) * size / 1000.0


def pdf_string(content_stream):
    """Assemble a minimal one-page PDF, returning bytes."""
    objects = []
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>")
    objects.append(
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> "
        b"/Contents 6 0 R >>"
    )
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>")
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    objects.append(
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content_stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
        + content_stream + b"\nendstream"
    )

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += str(i).encode() + b" 0 obj\n" + body + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    n = len(objects) + 1
    out += b"xref\n0 " + str(n).encode() + b"\n"
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode()
    out += (
        b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(n).encode() + b" /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        b"startxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n"
    )
    return bytes(out)


def build_cover(out_path):
    width_pt, height_pt = 612.0, 792.0

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    title_size = 30.0
    today = date.today()
    datestr = today.strftime("%B") + " " + str(today.day) + ", " + str(today.year)
    date_size = 16.0

    lines = []
    # Title centered horizontally, slightly above the vertical center.
    x = (width_pt - text_width(title, title_size, HELV_BOLD)) / 2.0
    y = height_pt / 2.0 + 40.0
    lines.append(
        "BT /F1 %f Tf 1 0 0 1 %f %f Tm (%s) Tj ET"
        % (title_size, x, y, title)
    )
    # Date line centered below the title.
    x = (width_pt - text_width(datestr, date_size, HELV)) / 2.0
    y = height_pt / 2.0 - 8.0
    lines.append(
        "BT /F2 %f Tf 1 0 0 1 %f %f Tm (%s) Tj ET"
        % (date_size, x, y, datestr)
    )
    # Decorative rule between title and date.
    lines.append("0.35 w 152 356 m 460 356 l S")

    content = ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("latin-1")
    data = pdf_string(content)
    with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)
    print("cover written:", out_path, "date:", datestr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build_cover("cover.pdf")
